manifest.name: understeer-bicycle-v1
manifest.description: Steady-state understeer bicycle (yaw = v*delta/(L+K_us*v^2)) with calibrated steering-ratio scale, steering offset, and a first-order yaw lag. Per-platform coefficients fitted on data/sim/segments truth.
manifest.training_data: data/sim/segments/<platform>/**/sim.csv (truth: yaw_rate_meas_rads, or psi_dot_rads for TESLA_MODEL_3 legacy schema)
notes: TESLA_MODEL_3 falls through to V0 (KS) because the legacy training data is KS-clean — psi_dot_rads is the KS simulator state, not a measured signal.
Coefficients fitted by Nelder-Mead minimisation of pooled per-platform yaw RMSE (see out/fit_final.py).
